report.explanation: Gateway telemetry is largely healthy (error_rate 0.0014, p95 79ms, no dependency timeouts, INFO 200 logs), yet one trace shows a gateway->inventory call erroring at 1943ms. Current evidence does not establish a bounded root cause on any taxonomy item; downstream hop data is missing, so hand off for targeted collection.
missing_evidence: Traces for order, inventory, payment, and postgresql services during the alert window to localize the failing hop
Error-rate and p95 latency metrics for order and inventory services
Inventory-to-redis span timings and timeout counts to test redis-timeout
Logs from order/inventory showing error details for the failing request
Confirmation of which service the alert's error-rate/latency threshold was breached on
